insert into wx_clickmodule_info
phone, wxName, moduleName, clickTime,
#{phone}, #{wxName}, #{moduleName}, #{clickTime},
mapper.select:
SELECT id,phone,wxName,moduleName,clickTime from wx_clickmodule_info
and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') and wxName like concat('%', #{wxName}, '%') and moduleName like concat('%', #{moduleName}, '%') and clickTime like concat('%', #{clickTime}, '%')

select * from ( select l.*, r.real_name as wxName FROM ( select phone, GROUP_CONCAT(t.clickCount) clickCount from ( select phone, CONCAT(moduleName,':',count(0)) as clickCount from wx_clickmodule_info where moduleName != 'undefined' AND moduleName != '' AND moduleName is not null
and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and moduleName like concat('%', #{moduleName}, '%')
and clickTime like concat('%', #{clickTime}, '%')
and DATE_FORMAT(clickTime, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startTime}
and DATE_FORMAT(clickTime, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY phone,moduleName ORDER BY phone ) t GROUP BY phone ) l LEFT JOIN wx_user_logininfo r ON l.phone = r.phone )g
and wxName like concat('%', #{wxName}, '%')

select a.phone, a.moduleName, a.clickTime, b.real_name as wxName from wx_clickmodule_info a LEFT JOIN wx_user_logininfo b on a.phone = b.phone where moduleName != 'undefined' AND moduleName != '' AND moduleName is not null
and a.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and a.moduleName like concat('%', #{moduleName}, '%')
and a.clickTime like concat('%', #{clickTime}, '%')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.clickTime, '%Y-%m-%d') >= #{startTime}
and DATE_FORMAT(a.clickTime, '%Y-%m-%d') <= #{endTime}
order by a.clickTime desc
